probe: same state + same Explorer action, 200 repetitions
finding: The Hunter is stochastic in all three modes; the Sentinel is deterministic.
consequence: STEP(state, action) is not a function. The premise in Fase 1 does not hold for the real runtime.

broadProbe.method: 40 repetitions of chooseGuardianMove from an identical (hunter, player) state across 12 maps

rootCause.easy: Math.random() < 0.5 picks a random neighbour, else a random not-closer one
rootCause.medium: Math.random() < 0.75 gates the greedy branch; otherwise a random neighbour
rootCause.hard: no explicit random gate, but pickRandom(best) breaks Manhattan ties at random
rootCause.alsoInHook: chooseGuardianMove itself calls randomItem for easy and for the best-alternative tie-break

verdict: STEP(state, action) is NOT a function. The mission Fase 1 premise does not hold, and it is not a missing state variable — it is genuine randomness in the approved Hunter policy.
